title: Complexity bounded by deterministic depth
statement: Let the input alphabet be finite and nonempty, and let $f$ be a function from length-$n$ inputs over this alphabet to an output alphabet. The randomized decision-tree complexity of $f$ is at most the least depth of a deterministic decision tree computing $f$.
hypotheses_covered: A function on length-$n$ inputs over the alphabet
